2833226.description: Avada is a multipurpose WordPress theme and website builder for business, agency, portfolio and WooCommerce sites. It combines a drag-and-drop builder with a large library of prebuilt website demos that can be imported and then edited section by section: headers, footers, menus, colours, typography and page layouts are all configured from the theme options rather than in code. WooCommerce support covers shop, category, product and checkout templates. The download contains the theme files, the bundled builder plugins, demo content and the documentation.
2833226.shortDescription: Multipurpose WordPress and WooCommerce theme with a drag-and-drop builder and importable demo sites.

4519990.description: Enfold is a clean, flexible and fully responsive multipurpose WordPress theme suited to business websites, shops and portfolio sites. It is built on the Avia Framework and includes a drag-and-drop layout builder, a set of prebuilt demo sites, and theme options for headers, footers, colours, typography and layout. WooCommerce templates are supported for shop and product pages. The download contains the theme files, the bundled builder, demo content and the installation and customisation documentation.
4519990.shortDescription: Clean, responsive multipurpose WordPress theme built on the Avia Framework with a drag-and-drop builder.

5484319.description: Flatsome is a multipurpose responsive WooCommerce theme for online shops of any size. It includes a live page builder, prebuilt shop demos, and WooCommerce templates for category, product, cart and checkout pages, along with product galleries, quick view, wishlist and side-cart components. Headers, footers, colours and typography are configured from the theme options. The download contains the theme files, the bundled builder, demo content for one-click import and the setup documentation.
5484319.shortDescription: Multipurpose responsive WooCommerce theme with a live page builder and prebuilt shop demos.

5489609.description: Newspaper is a WordPress theme for news sites, magazines and online publications that also sell products through WooCommerce. It includes magazine home page demos, a front-end page builder for article and archive layouts, category and tag templates, video and gallery post formats, and built-in advertising placements. WooCommerce templates cover shop, product and checkout pages. The download contains the theme files, bundled plugins, demo content and the setup documentation.
5489609.shortDescription: News and magazine WordPress theme with WooCommerce templates, ad placements and a front-end builder.

7758048.description: Betheme is a multipurpose WordPress and WooCommerce theme supplied with a large collection of ready-made website demos covering business, agency, shop, blog and landing-page use cases. Each demo can be imported and then reworked in the page builder, with global controls for headers, footers, colours, fonts and layout width. WooCommerce templates are included for shop, product, cart and checkout pages. The download contains the theme files, bundled builder and demo-import plugins, demo content and the setup documentation.
7758048.shortDescription: Multipurpose WordPress and WooCommerce theme with a large library of importable prebuilt demos.

9207399.description: Porto is a multipurpose WordPress and WooCommerce theme supplied with a large set of prebuilt shop and business demos. It includes a page builder, header and footer builders, WooCommerce templates for category, product, cart and checkout pages, and components such as product filters, quick view, wishlist and comparison. Performance and layout options are set from the theme panel. The download contains the theme files, bundled plugins, demo content for one-click import and the documentation.
9207399.shortDescription: Multipurpose WooCommerce WordPress theme with prebuilt shop demos, header builder and product filters.

12170274.description: Masterstudy is a WordPress theme for online course platforms, training centres, universities and individual instructors. It includes course catalogue and single-course layouts, instructor and student profile pages, lesson and quiz views, pricing and membership sections, and blog and contact templates. It is designed to work with a learning-management plugin that adds enrolment, course progress and certificates. The download contains the theme files, bundled plugins, demo content and the documentation.
12170274.shortDescription: Education WordPress theme for course platforms with catalogue, lesson, quiz and instructor layouts.

12945398.description: Soledad is a multipurpose WordPress theme for blogs, magazines, news sites and WooCommerce shops. It ships with a large collection of blog and magazine demos, multiple post and archive layouts, gallery and video post formats, sidebar and grid configurations, and WooCommerce templates for shop and product pages. Colours, typography and layout options are set from the theme panel. The download contains the theme files, bundled plugins, demo content and the documentation.
12945398.shortDescription: Multipurpose blog, magazine and WooCommerce WordPress theme with a large library of demo layouts.

13373220.description: Uncode is a creative multipurpose WordPress and WooCommerce theme aimed at agencies, portfolios and design-led shops. It includes an adaptive grid system for portfolio and gallery layouts, a page builder with reusable content blocks, header and menu variants, and WooCommerce templates for catalogue and product pages. Typography, spacing and colour systems are managed from the theme options. The download contains the theme files, bundled plugins, demo content and the setup documentation.
13373220.shortDescription: Creative WordPress and WooCommerce theme with an adaptive portfolio grid and reusable content blocks.

14058034.description: Eduma is a WordPress theme for universities, schools, academies and online learning sites. It provides education home page variants, course catalogue and single-course layouts, instructor profiles, event and news sections, and admissions and contact pages. It is designed to work with the LearnPress learning-management plugin, which adds courses, lessons, quizzes, enrolment and student profiles. The download contains the theme files, the bundled education plugins, demo content for one-click import and the documentation.
14058034.shortDescription: Education WordPress theme for schools and online courses, built to work with the LearnPress LMS plugin.

15777451.description: Foodly is a Shopify theme for grocery, supermarket and food delivery stores. It includes a mega-menu suited to large catalogues, collection pages with filtering, product layouts with variant and quantity controls, deal-of-the-day and promotional sections, and blog and contact templates. Sections are managed from the Shopify theme editor so the home page can be reordered without editing code. The download contains the theme package for upload to a Shopify store and the installation documentation.
15777451.shortDescription: Shopify grocery and food-store theme with mega-menu navigation, collection filtering and promo sections.

15780546.description: XStore is a multipurpose WooCommerce theme supplied with a large library of prebuilt shop demos across fashion, electronics, furniture and general retail. It includes header, footer, single-product and checkout builders, AJAX product filtering and search, variant swatches, quick view, wishlist and comparison, and a side cart. The download contains the theme files, bundled plugins, demo content for one-click import and the installation and setup documentation.
15780546.shortDescription: Multipurpose WooCommerce theme with prebuilt shop demos plus header, product and checkout builders.

15995336.description: Auto Showroom is a WordPress theme built for car dealerships, rental fleets and vehicle marketplaces. It ships with a vehicle inventory system, filterable search by make, model, year, price and body type, individual vehicle detail pages with specification tables and image galleries, plus dealer, financing, service and contact page layouts. Layouts, colours and typography are configured from the theme options and the bundled page builder, without editing code. The download contains the theme files, demo content for one-click import and the installation and setup documentation.
15995336.shortDescription: Car dealership WordPress theme with vehicle inventory, filtered search and editable page layouts.

20264492.description: WoodMart is a multipurpose WooCommerce theme for online shops, supplied with a large set of prebuilt store demos. It includes AJAX shop filtering and search, product layouts with variant swatches, quick view, wishlist and comparison, a side cart, and header, footer and single-product builders. Layout and performance options are set from the theme panel. The download contains the theme files, bundled plugins, demo content for one-click import and the documentation.
20264492.shortDescription: Multipurpose WooCommerce theme with AJAX shop filtering, swatches, side cart and layout builders.

20566392.description: JNews is a WordPress theme for newspapers, magazines, news portals and content-heavy blogs. It ships with multiple magazine home page demos, a block-based article builder, category and archive layouts, post format support for video and gallery articles, and AMP-ready templates for mobile. Advertising placements, related-post modules and newsletter blocks are built in, and WooCommerce templates are available for selling alongside content. The download contains the theme files, bundled plugins, demo content and the documentation.
20566392.shortDescription: Newspaper, magazine and blog WordPress theme with AMP support and a block-based article builder.

23954567.description: Uray is a multipurpose Shopify theme for fashion, furniture, cosmetics and beauty stores. It includes several home page presets, collection pages with filtering and sorting, product layouts with variant swatches and quick view, lookbook and promotional sections, and blog and contact templates. Sections are configured from the Shopify theme editor, so the storefront can be restyled per campaign without editing Liquid. The download contains the theme package for upload to a Shopify store and the setup documentation.
23954567.shortDescription: Multipurpose Shopify theme for fashion, furniture and beauty stores with lookbook and promo sections.

24623576.description: PayeeShop is a multipurpose Shopify theme aimed at electronics, gadget and accessory stores with large catalogues. It includes a mega-menu, collection pages with filtering and sorting, product layouts with specification tabs, variant swatches and quick view, comparison and wishlist blocks, and blog and contact templates. Sections are configured from the Shopify theme editor. The download contains the theme package for upload to a Shopify store and the installation documentation.
24623576.shortDescription: Shopify theme for electronics and gadget stores with mega-menu, spec tabs and comparison blocks.

32330905.description: Karl is a Shopify theme for beauty, cosmetics, skincare and personal-care stores. It includes several home page presets, collection pages with filtering, product layouts with variant swatches, ingredient and routine content blocks, bundle and upsell sections, and blog and contact templates. Sections are configured from the Shopify theme editor, so campaigns and merchandising can be changed without editing Liquid. The download contains the theme package for upload to a Shopify store and the setup documentation.
32330905.shortDescription: Shopify theme for beauty and cosmetics stores with editable sections, swatches and upsell blocks.

49061887.description: Sierra is a WordPress theme for SaaS products, technology startups and software and app development companies. It includes several product-led home pages, feature and integration sections, pricing tables with monthly and annual toggles, case-study and changelog layouts, and blog, careers and contact templates. Pages are built with Elementor, so sections, colours and typography can be edited visually without touching code. The download contains the theme files, demo content for one-click import and the setup documentation.
49061887.shortDescription: SaaS and tech startup WordPress theme with pricing tables, feature sections and Elementor layouts.

49402341.description: EduBlink is a WordPress theme for schools, training providers, coaches and online course platforms. It ships with multiple education-focused home pages, course listing and single-course layouts, instructor and event pages, and admissions, about and contact templates. The theme is compatible with the common WordPress LMS and course plugins, so lessons, enrolment and student dashboards can be added on top of the design. The download contains the theme files, demo content for one-click import and the setup documentation.
49402341.shortDescription: Education and online-course WordPress theme with course, instructor and event page layouts.

53006461.description: Glozin is a multipurpose Shopify theme with right-to-left (RTL) language support, suited to fashion, electronics, furniture and general retail stores. It includes multiple home page presets, collection pages with filtering and sorting, product layouts with variant swatches and quick view, a cart drawer, and blog and contact templates. All sections are editable from the Shopify theme editor. The download contains the theme package for upload to a Shopify store and the setup documentation.
53006461.shortDescription: Multipurpose Shopify theme with RTL support, editable sections and filtered collection pages.

57923671.description: Revone is a versatile Shopify theme for multi-category stores, covering fashion, electronics, home and lifestyle catalogues. It includes multiple home page presets, collection pages with filtering and sorting, product layouts with variant swatches, quick view and sticky add-to-cart, promotional and upsell sections, and blog and contact templates. All sections are editable from the Shopify theme editor. The download contains the theme package for upload to a Shopify store and the setup documentation.
57923671.shortDescription: Versatile multi-category Shopify theme with sticky add-to-cart, quick view and upsell sections.

58471880.description: Kidioz is a Shopify theme for baby shops, kids' clothing and toy stores. It includes colourful home page presets, age- and category-based collection pages with filtering, product layouts with size and colour swatches, gift and bundle sections, and blog and contact templates. All sections are editable from the Shopify theme editor. The download contains the theme package for upload to a Shopify store and the installation and setup documentation.
58471880.shortDescription: Shopify theme for baby and kids' stores with filtered collections, swatches and gift sections.

58890764.description: Glozin for WooCommerce is a multipurpose WordPress and WooCommerce theme for fashion, electronics, furniture and general retail stores. It includes several shop home page presets, product listing pages with AJAX filtering, product layouts with variant swatches and quick view, a side cart, and blog and contact templates. Layouts are edited in the bundled page builder and theme options. The download contains the theme files, bundled plugins, demo content for one-click import and the documentation.
58890764.shortDescription: Multipurpose WooCommerce WordPress theme with AJAX shop filtering, quick view and side cart.

59829862.description: Mitti is a Shopify theme for home decor, handmade goods and craft stores, with a conversion-focused layout. It includes multiple home page presets, collection pages with filtering, product layouts with variant swatches, gallery blocks and trust badges, bundle and upsell sections, and blog and contact templates. Sections are configured from the Shopify theme editor. The download contains the theme package for upload to a Shopify store and the installation documentation.
59829862.shortDescription: Shopify theme for home decor and craft stores with conversion-focused sections and upsell blocks.

60797168.description: Pawzy is a Shopify theme for pet shops, veterinary stores and animal-care brands. It includes home page presets for pet food, accessories and grooming, collection pages with filtering by pet type and category, product layouts with variant swatches and subscription-friendly blocks, and blog and contact templates. Sections are editable from the Shopify theme editor. The download contains the theme package for upload to a Shopify store and the setup documentation.
60797168.shortDescription: Shopify theme for pet and animal stores with pet-type filtering, swatches and editable sections.

61417244.description: Feezee is a Shopify theme for food, beverage, bakery, café and grocery stores, with a playful, colourful visual style. It includes multiple home page presets, collection and product page layouts, a quick-view and cart drawer, promotional banner and bundle sections, and blog and contact templates. Sections are configured from the Shopify theme editor, so merchandising blocks can be rearranged per page without editing Liquid. The download contains the theme package for upload to a Shopify store and the setup documentation.
61417244.shortDescription: Playful Shopify theme for food and beverage stores with editable sections and merchandising blocks.

61420580.description: Univet is a WordPress theme for universities, colleges and higher-education institutions. It includes campus home page variants, faculty and department pages, course and programme listings, admissions and tuition layouts, event and news sections, and staff, gallery and contact templates. Pages are assembled in the page builder and styled from the theme options. The download contains the theme files, demo content for one-click import and the installation and customisation documentation.
61420580.shortDescription: University and higher-education WordPress theme with programme, faculty, admissions and event pages.

61512877.description: Brickz is a WordPress theme for construction companies, contractors, builders, architects and industrial services. It includes home page variants, project and case-study layouts with portfolio filtering, service pages, team and testimonial sections, a quote-request form and blog templates. Pages are assembled in the bundled page builder, so sections can be rearranged and restyled visually. The download contains the theme files, demo content for one-click import and the installation and customisation documentation.
61512877.shortDescription: Construction and contractor WordPress theme with project portfolio and service page layouts.

61829280.description: Inotek is a WordPress theme for IT companies, software houses, technology consultancies and managed-service providers. It includes business home page variants, service and solution pages, case-study and portfolio layouts, pricing and team sections, and blog and contact templates. Pages are assembled visually in the page builder and styled from the theme options. The download contains the theme files, demo content for one-click import and the installation and customisation documentation.
61829280.shortDescription: IT solutions and technology WordPress theme with service, case-study and pricing page layouts.

62056044.description: Luvix is a multipurpose Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme built around reusable theme blocks, so sections and individual blocks can be added, reordered and restyled directly in the Shopify theme editor. It includes multiple home page presets for fashion, electronics, home and general retail, collection pages with filtering and sorting, product layouts with variant swatches and quick view, a cart drawer, and blog and contact templates. The download contains the theme package for upload to a Shopify store and the setup documentation.
62056044.shortDescription: Multipurpose Shopify OS 2.0 theme built on reusable theme blocks with multiple store presets.
